def: Tending to mitigate or alleviate; mitigative.
To hire, as a ship, for the transportation of goods or freight.
Not adhering; loose; -- opposed to adnate; as, a solutestipule.
A bad quality or disposition in a disease; an incurable ulcer.
A postponement of the decision of a cause, for furtherconsideration or re-argument.
A coronet or little crown of a seed; the downy tuft on seeds.See Pappus. Martyn.
Full; heavy; firm; solid; substemtial. [Obs.]A cold May and a windy Makes the barn fat amd findy. Old Prover
